# P31.10 (DEEPEN.6): camera-site review surface over PostgreSQL

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.10__camera-site-review-surface.md` (Round 9 Wave B, manifest
row 151; advances — does not close — deferral **D-P30.2b-1**). Live-verified
(`live_verification=true`): the new sqitch change was deployed to hosted `sig-pg`, the
seeded sampler ran read-only and materialized a Round-10-prepared campaign append-only,
and the loopback curation app was exercised against the hosted DSN — with **zero**
camera-site decisions created. Stacked on the P31.9 tip
`devin/p31-9-negative-space-peer-classes`.

This ticket is deliberately **tooling only**. The ~11,625 pending camera-site review
proposals the hosted spine carries (P30.2b) had no working human surface — the curation
app only knew the in-memory demo queue. P31.10 supplies the PG-backed surface, the
stratified sampler, and the offline labelling path so the **Round-10** human review can
run; it runs no campaign and records no decisions itself.

## Summary

- **PG-backed queue in the curation app (`api/curation.py`, `api/cli.py`).**
  `sig-api serve-curation --dsn … --role sig_materialize` backs the queue with
  `PgReviewQueue`; without a DSN the demo-seed queue is unchanged. `GET
  /v1/curation/review-queue` accepts `family` (default `camera-site`, which maps to the
  `er_match:camera_site:` + `er_match:camera_site_disputed:` prefixes and excludes the
  P31.3 `er_match:identity_duplicate:` family by construction), repeatable `prefix`,
  `tier`, `bucket` (stratum), `campaign`, `limit`. Zero-JS HTML queue + item pages render
  for a loopback walkthrough under `Accept: text/html`. Routes remain absent unless
  `SIG_CURATION_ENABLED=1` — loopback-only, never mounted on the public app (ADR-068).
- **Evidence view.** `GET …/{item_id}` projects the two observations per pair — source,
  external ref, operator, jurisdiction, name/roadway/direction, coordinates — plus
  distance, matcher tier/label, score, and soft-conflict reason. Coordinates are reduced
  per §19.4 at the *curator's* tier (anonymous/registered → 1 km grid, trusted_reviewer →
  2-dp truncation, curator/maintainer → full precision — the claims are sensitivity_tier
  0 and published at C1 anyway); the applied `geo_tier` is recorded in the view. No raw
  person data anywhere.
- **Decisions.** POST `decide` persists only `accept`/`reject` (the UI's `match` /
  `no-match` spellings map; anything else → 400) through `PgReviewQueue.decide`, with
  `reviewer` = the pseudonymous tier-token handle. `defer`/`unsure` deliberately write
  **no** `review_decision` — the item stays pending (the schema has no third value;
  persisting one would need a new sqitch change + ADR).
- **Stratified sampler (`resolution/camera_site_review.py`, `resolution/cli.py`).**
  `sig-resolution review sample --dsn … --strata … --n … --seed …` draws a seeded,
  reproducible, deterministic sample of *pending* camera-site items across the stratum
  vocabulary — tiers `1g/3g/4g/5g`, the `soft_conflict:*` bucket, and the disputed bucket
  (`camera_site_disputed:` prefix or `active_learning:adjudicator_disagreement`) — with
  quota defaults from the §6 Q11 design (~400) and sizes as CLI parameters; auto-write
  tiers are deliberately included for human auditing. `--campaign <id>` tags the draw
  append-only; a re-draw of the same design under the same id is `+0`, and a different
  design under a taken id is refused (digest-pinned). `--dry-run` never writes.
- **New sqitch change `review_campaign`.** Append-only `review_campaign` (caller-chosen
  id, purpose, full design jsonb, tool/engineering `created_by` — never a person) +
  `review_campaign_item` (PK `(campaign_id, item_id)`, stratum recorded; `ON CONFLICT DO
  NOTHING` → idempotent re-draws). Grants mirror the least-privilege split:
  `sig_materialize` gets SELECT+INSERT on both **and INSERT on `review_decision`** (so the
  curation write path runs under the limited role); `sig_read_public`/`sig_export` get
  SELECT. Verify asserts the read-role INSERT refusal and that no UPDATE/DELETE grants
  exist. Deploy/revert/verify + plan entry; **deployed hosted**: `+ review_campaign .. ok`.
- **Offline path.** `review export [--campaign|filters]` emits a JSONL labelling session;
  `review import` appends its decisions through the same `PgReviewQueue.decide` path
  (same accept/reject validation, same append-only row shape).

## Hosted verification (project `zeta-medley-508121-u7`, Cloud SQL proxy :5433)

- Pre-state (read-only): 11,591 `camera_site:` + 34 `camera_site_disputed:` + 3
  `identity_duplicate:` pending; strata **1g=1, 4g=1,552, 5g=9,970, soft-conflict=25,
  disputed=77** (11,625 pending camera-site); **0** camera-site `review_decision` rows.
- `sqitch deploy --verify` (Docker, `sig` owner): `+ review_campaign .. ok`.
- Sampler as `sig_materialize`, seed `round10-v1`, `n=400` → drawn 1g=1, 3g=0, 4g=242,
  5g=66, soft-conflict=25, disputed=66 (400 unique; digest `b090bc07…fda`). Materialized
  as **`camsite-r10-seed-round10-v1`** — purpose "prepared for Round 10 (P31.10 tooling;
  the human review campaign is Round 10)". Re-run: `items_inserted=0,
  items_skipped_existing=400`. SQL read-back: 400 items, 0 identity-duplicate leakage,
  `sig_read_public` SELECTs both tables but INSERT is refused.
- **Loopback walkthrough:** `serve-curation --dsn <hosted> --role sig_materialize` on
  `127.0.0.1` — 401 without a token; queue JSON/HTML over hosted items (campaign filter
  renders the drawn set); the evidence page shows e.g. the OR-DOT vs WA-DOT
  `soft_conflict:jurisdiction` pair 0.0 m apart; a trusted-reviewer token sees 2-dp
  reduced coordinates vs curator full precision; `POST decide` with `unsure` →
  `{"deferred": true, "review_decision": null}`; invalid values → 400. **Post-check:
  camera-site decisions still 0.**

## Tests

- `tests/db/test_camera_site_review.py` (real PG): decide → `review_decision` row with
  the pseudonymous curator handle; defer/unsure persist nothing; stratum/bucket filters;
  identity-duplicate exclusion; campaign materialize + idempotent re-draw + conflicting
  design refused; read-role INSERT refusal; JSONL round trip.
- `tests/api/test_curation_pg.py`: PG-mode list filters + bad-family 400; evidence view
  with per-tier coordinate reduction (reviewer 2-dp vs curator full); decide semantics
  (accept/reject persist, defer writes nothing, bogus → 400); HTML surfaces; demo path
  unchanged without DSN; routes absent unless enabled.
- `tests/resolution/test_review_sampler.py`: stratum mapping (tier/reason/prefix),
  seeded reproducibility (same seed → identical ids), quota redistribution, JSONL
  export/import helpers.

## Scope notes

- Runs **no** review campaign and creates **no** decisions — `camera-site` decisions on
  hosted remain 0.
- Does not wire decisions into `camera_site_match` clustering — **P31.11**.
- **D-P30.2b-1** gets an appended engineering-intake note and stays **OPEN**;
